It compared current source/input trees only with those mutable manifests. Coherently changing an input/source plus its manifest could pass with unchanged HEAD while violating the approved hashes. Check both manifest hashes and sourceCommit on every guard.

[P2] FG-SPEC-02 — original fixedFiles pinned observer/provenance but never the actual Go executable named by the observer. observer-provenance.json recorded realGoSHA256, yet replacement bytes at /usr/local/go/bin/go would still run the four commands without guard rejection. Retain the existing observer and guard the real Go bytes before/after too, as the earlier reviewed compiled helper did.

The prospective updated controller visibly implements both corrections, including an absolute real-Go fixedFile and repeated approved-plan equality. That is not approval of a future prepared plan. Gate-1 remains PREPARED/unrun and source745 will be superseded by the independent metadata HOME correction; no approval file is written. The unchanged observer hashaec940… still selects exactly four native commands at exact ROOTcwd and passes through real Go. The planned compiled public CLI has17 own inputs, four current effects,6600s bound, no bundle-adoption flags or selected credentials. Fresh source/input/binary/controller/plan pins and exact runtime review are required before gate-2.
